clips.title: The story
paras: The Burning Steppes are a scorched, volcanic wasteland flanking the southern base of Blackrock Mountain. Formed by the catastrophic summoning of Ragnaros centuries ago, this treacherous territory holds the primary overland passage between Stormwind and Khaz Modan. Today, it crawls with rogue Blackrock orcs, Firegut ogres, Dark Iron dwarves, and broodlings of the black dragonflight.

Long ago, these foothills were simply the northern reaches of the Redridge Mountains. During the War of the Three Hammers, the exiled Dark Iron clan established their kingdom here, raising their capital city of Thaurissan. Facing total defeat at the hands of the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer clans, the desperate Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan attempted to conjure elemental forces. Instead, he shattered the earth and summoned Ragnaros the Firelord into Azeroth. The violent explosion pulverized the surrounding mountains, tore open rivers of lava, and birthed the colossal volcano known as Blackrock Mountain, leaving the steppes forever charred and barren.

During the Second War, the Old Horde claimed Blackrock Spire as its foremost seat of power. At the climax of the conflict, the Grand Alliance of Lordaeron pushed deep into the Burning Steppes to lay siege to the mountain. It was at the foot of Blackrock Mountain that Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer clashed with Lord Anduin Lothar, striking down the human champion. Rather than breaking the Alliance's resolve, Lothar's death galvanized the Allied armies to rout the orcs, sealing the victory of the Second War and leaving behind an enduring valley of ash and rusted steel.

Though Thrall established a New Horde in distant Kalimdor, the Blackrock clan remaining in the steppes maintains the bloodthirsty cruelty of the Old Horde. Operating from Blackrock Stronghold, these orcs openly ally with the black dragonflight and local Firegut ogres rather than honor any truce. Meanwhile, Dark Iron dwarves and elemental servitors lurk among the fiery ruins, all while black drakes and wyrmkin prey upon unwary travelers attempting to use the thoroughfare to cross between Stormwind and the northern kingdoms.
